exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: Set feet roughly shoulder width, toes slightly outward if comfortable. Grip the barbell at comfortable hand width (i.e., index fingers on the rings), lightly pressing the bar into your upper traps. With torso upright, sink into the hole until thighs are parallel with the ground, weight distributed evenly through your feet. Pressing through your heels and balls of feet, fire glutes and quads to return to starting position, keeping chest upright.

exercises.name: Barbell Benchpress
exercises.instructions: Sit on the bench, facing away from the barbell. Lean your torso back onto the bench, eyes slightly in front of the bar. Grip the barbell firmly; a wider grip focuses chest, whereas narrow will focus triceps. With core engaged, press feet firmly into the floor, firing the hips. Pinching shoulder blades back into the bench, unrack the weight with locked elbows, bringing the bar out in line with the chest. Lower bar onto the chest while keeping core tight and shoulder blades retracted, elbows roughly at a 45 degree angle. Touch down, and press up using the pectorals until elbows are locked, shoulder blades still retracted.
